answer_1.quote: We explore the use of large language models to generate guiding sub-questions for math word problems... The main module is the Question Generator (QG) module, which is a transformer based encoder-decoder model.
answer_1.outputs: generated sub-questions (Socratic questions) for each step of a math word problem

answer_2.quote: Similar to the BLEU score, we achieve better performance on BERT F1 scores too... QA accuracy is reported for various configurations.

answer_4.quote: We performed a human evaluation of the questions generated for 100 randomly selected test MWPs... A 5-point Likert scale ranging from 1 (poor) to 5 (very good) was used for each dimensions of quality assessment: repetition, factuality, logical relevance, right sequence, granularity, completeness, and fluency.
answer_4.guideline: Crowdsourced annotators rated each generated question on a 5‑point Likert scale for multiple quality dimensions.
